subject.title: [Feature]: Visible agent-to-agent messaging for ACP thread-bound sessions (proxy-only delivery without main session creation)

question: Which visible coordinator-to-ACP-thread delivery contract should OpenClaw support without creating main Discord channel-session metadata?
rationale: The choices alter public tool/API semantics, session ownership, and Discord account authorization, so code inspection cannot safely choose the product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add visible sessions_send semantics
options.body: Expose an explicit visible A2A send that posts the coordinator-authored instruction to the target ACP-bound route while preserving target-session ownership.

options.title: Add proxy-only message delivery
options.body: Allow a message or gateway send to bypass outbound main-session mirroring only for an authorized proxy call with strict account and thread checks.

options.title: Defer to plugin orchestration
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged and require supervised A2A orchestration to live in plugins unless a narrower core API gap is approved.

recommendation.title: Add visible sessions_send semantics
recommendation.body: Expose an explicit visible A2A send that posts the coordinator-authored instruction to the target ACP-bound route while preserving target-session ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across sessions_send, outbound mirroring, Discord route handling, and the product/security boundary that this decision touches.
